assumptions: All tax values are fictional demo estimates.
Texas has no state income tax, so this projection is federal only — there is no state balance, state withholding, or state fix.
Wages annualize the current pay stubs (Daniel $6,100 gross per check, Maya $4,250); each stub’s federal withholding x 24 is the withholding shown.
Daniel’s withholding reflects the W-4 from his June role change; it annualizes about 4% light.
The 1099 income is Maya’s two-week contract stretch in February; no quarterly estimates were paid on it.
Interest and dividends are the Cedar Bank and brokerage year-to-date figures, grossed up for December.
